source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
For Singles, round 1 is usually paired at random. Later rounds can be paired many ways; the recommended criteria, in order:

1. win, loss and draw record, e.g. 2 players at 3–1 meet
2. win path: when in the event each win and loss came
3. at random among players with the same ranking

recommendedOrder: record of wins, losses and draws
random among players in the same bracket
